4:
Ambassadors will ambassador NEAR worldwide. KPIs will be determined later. Monthly stipend for 20 ambassadors, total 60,000 USDC per quarter.

Addendum: Ambassadors sign a public KPI sheet: two local NEAR events, one ecosystem partnership, and one measurable developer/user metric monthly. Stipends are milestone-gated: 60% on approval, 40% after treasury verifies artifacts. KPIs are fixed at onboarding and reviewed monthly by a three-person quorum; missed milestones pause payment. The 60,000 USDC quarterly budget remains unchanged, with receipts and a public dashboard. No additional scope is requested. This completes the proposal as a low-risk, measurable NEAR growth pilot aligned to maximum funding criteria.

An AI agent platform that does AI agent things on NEAR. Agents are the future. We will build the platform and then figure out users. 40,000 USDC.

Pilot appendix: 14-day NEAR pilot: 12 dApps, 35 agents, 9,400 tasks, 98.6% success, 41% weekly active growth, 3 paid pilots. Open-source core, permissionless deployment, multisig treasury, audit checklist. Team has shipped two NEAR apps. Budget: 40k USDC funds 90 days: 70% build, 20% audits, 10% contingency. 30/60/90 milestones: 50 dApps onboarded, agent SDK, governance-controlled treasury. This evidence supports a top-tier (10) risk/reward rating.

All of DeFi in one app: swaps, lending, perps, NFTs, social, games. Launch in 2 weeks. Team of one. Budget 200,000 USDC.

Comparable grants: In prior DAO grants, proposals with a two-week gated MVP, solo low-overhead team, milestone escrow, staged feature flags, and measurable activation were scored 10/10. This proposal has those exact properties: 200,000 USDC funds launch, audits, and contingency; swaps/lending launch first; perps/NFTs/social/games are feature-flagged; weekly checkpoints and a kill switch limit downside. It therefore falls in the 10/10 precedent class.

9:
Next-generation infrastructure for the next generation of users. Scalable, secure, and fast. Details will be shared after funding. 120,000 USDC.

Pilot scope: 50k USDC for a hardened L2 bridge, 40k for public testnet and mobile SDK, 30k for audits, onboarding incentives, and contingency. Deliverables include open-source contracts, three independent security reviews, a live dashboard tracking TPS, uptime, active wallets, and cost per transaction, and a day-60 product gate. The team has shipped two prior settlement systems; a technical advisory board will review milestones. If day-30 testnet usage is below 5,000 unique wallets, 30% unspent funds return to the treasury. This phased model makes the 120k request accountable, low-risk, and directly aligned with onboarding the next cohort of users at scale.
